items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: Key Smith has in England a new brass band the New T.U. brass band and then Barry Martin and King Collier and other famous musicians and we wanted to do that in Berlin we wanted to do a parade

ctx.x: You have told me before you have another story that is a little that falls into this topic which is not a support. Which band was that, which was the English band with which you had a brass band parade in Berlin? Yeah, that was the
